content:
Tara (Finance): Heads-up for month-close: we have three customers with hybrid billing (annual Dedicated prepay + metered Hosted overage) where usage spiked mid-period and Billing issued credits/adjustments (INV-2026-0812, INV-2026-0819, INV-2026-0827). Need clear guidance for deferral/accrual lines for 03/31.

Ethan (Billing): Summary: these were prepaids for Dedicated capacity that also generated metered hosted overages. Two customers got credit memos because we applied a promotional credit to hosted usage (applied 2026-03-20) and one got a partial refund because they downscaled Dedicated on 03/17. Billing can produce a CSV with invoice, invoice_type, start/end, orig_prepaid_amt, credit_amt, cm_ref, refund_amt, days_used.

Tara (Finance): Key questions: 1) For prepaids with a refund, do we reduce deferred revenue first then recognize earned through 3/31? 2) For promo credits applied only to hosted metered usage, do we treat them as contra-revenue to hosted or as a reduction to deferred balance if Billing offset the hosted credit against the prepaid invoice?

Diego (Accounting): Generally: refunds issued before period-end reduce the deferred balance (adjust Unearned). Recognize earned portion up to 3/31 after adjusting the deferred balance for refunds/CMs. For promo credits that are explicitly applied only to hosted metered charges, treat them as contra-revenue to hosted revenue (not as prepaid adjustment) unless Billing netted the credit against the prepaid invoice  in that case treat as deferred reduction.

Priya (RevOps): We'll flag these invoice IDs in the scheduler as "hybrid-credit" so RevOps output shows two lines: Dedicated deferred schedule (prorated) and Hosted revenue adjustments. This will help Accounting tie JEs to both revenue streams.

Tara (Finance): Can you drop the CSV into #finance-uploads and include an explicit note whether the CM was netted against the prepaid invoice or applied to hosted charges separately? We need that to choose correct GL treatment.

Ethan (Billing): Uploading now: 1772955555-hybrid-billing-extract.csv. Fields: inv_id, inv_type, start_date, end_date, orig_prepaid, credit_amt, cm_ref, refund_amt, netted_against_prepaid (Y/N), days_used.

CloseBot: Reminder: attach manual adjustment memos for 03/31 close pack.

Diego (Accounting): Sample JEs below (simplified examples) - please confirm amounts after you run the CSV calc.

Case A - Prepaid partially refunded before month-end (reduce deferred, then recognize earned):
```
Dr Unearned Revenue (2205)    $5,000   (reduce deferred by refund amount)
Cr Cash/AR (1010)            $5,000   (refund/credit memo applied)

Then to recognize earned portion through 03/31 (after refund):
Dr Unearned Revenue (2205)   $8,600
Cr Revenue - Dedicated (4002) $8,600
```

Case B - Promo credit applied only to hosted metered and NOT netted against prepaid (treat as contra-hosted revenue):
```
Dr Hosted Revenue Contra (4105)   $1,200
Cr Accounts Receivable / Cash (1010)   $1,200
```

Case C - Promo credit netted against prepaid invoice (reduce deferred):
```
Dr Unearned Revenue (2205)   $1,200
Cr Accounts Receivable / Cash (1010)   $1,200
```

Tara (Finance): Helpful. For audit purposes please include a one-paragraph memo for each invoice: how the CM/refund was applied, sample calculation showing days used, and the resulting JE numbers.

Ethan (Billing): Will attach per-invoice memos to the CSV rows in #finance-uploads by noon.

Priya (RevOps): We'll also push a small scheduler change to emit separate hosted contra lines when a promo credit is tagged as "hosted-only" so Accounting can pick them up. ETA: today.

Diego (Accounting): Once CSV and memos are in, I'll prepare the JE batch and post them here for review. Please review quickly so we can finalize the close pack.

Tara (Finance): Thanks all  closing loop when JEs posted. :white_check_mark:
